name: Chamber of Atonement
summary: Captured undead and accused heretics face interrogation and torture in the Chamber of Atonement. At the entrance to the Scarlet Monastery's Graveyard wing, the hall opens onto the cloister where the Scarlet Crusade casts their remains.

sections.title: A Hall of Agony
sections.body: The Chamber of Atonement opens onto the Forlorn Cloister, where no peace or prayer waits. The Scarlet Crusade has filled this grand entry hall with racks, shackles, and burning braziers. Zealous inquisitors use them to force confessions and torment captives. They believe unholy beings deserve pain as penance, while cries echo and cruel taskmasters keep watch.

sections.title: The Interrogator's Domain
sections.body: Interrogator Vishas oversees the chamber. He takes pride in breaking anyone caught crossing the monastery's boundaries. The Forsaken captive Vorrel Sengutz has endured weeks of torment at his hands. Here, the Scarlet Crusade's campaign for purity has turned to sadism.

faq.q: What is the Chamber of Atonement used for?
aliases: why are there torture devices here
what happens in chamber of atonement
faq.answer: In the monastery's Graveyard wing, the Scarlet Crusade uses the Chamber of Atonement to interrogate and torture captives. Forsaken and others it sees as enemies are questioned and tormented with brutal implements before their bodies are cast into the graveyard.
Interrogator Vishas commands the chamber. The Scarlet Crusade torturer takes pleasure in his victims' suffering.

aliases: where does chamber of atonement go
faq.answer: The Chamber of Atonement opens directly into the Forlorn Cloister, at the outermost edge of the Graveyard wing. Fallen Crusaders and restless dead dwell in its open-air cemetery grounds.

faq.q: Who is being held captive here?
faq.answer: Vorrel Sengutz, a Forsaken captive, has been imprisoned and tortured by Interrogator Vishas for weeks.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the Chamber of Atonement shows the Scarlet Crusade's cruelty toward your people. Captive Forsaken like Vorrel Sengutz are tortured here for existing.
Here, the Scarlet Crusade's interrogators turn sacred discipline into physical torment. The chamber shows how far they have strayed from holy vows.
